The City of La Habra Heights complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerkâ€™s office at (562) 694-6302.
Materials related to any items on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection at the City Clerkâ€™s Office at 1245 N. Hacienda Road, La Habra Heights, CA 90631 during normal business hours.
PUBLIC COMMENT PROCESS
Each member of the public may speak for a total of five minutes on any action item listed on the agenda or other matters within the Councilâ€™s purview except with regard to items listed as public hearings. To speak in the Public Comment segment please complete and deliver a speakerâ€™s card to the Clerk prior to the call for public comments. You will be called to the podium by name when it is your turn to speak.
During a Public Hearing: Each member of the public may also speak on each public hearing item. Please provide a speakerâ€™s card listing the public hearing by number and submit it to the Clerk before the hearing is opened by the Mayor. Your speaking time will be limited to the subject of the hearing. In general, speakers are given three minutes. However, the Mayor may limit speaking time during public hearings if several people wish to speak.
Should you need to provide written documentation, please give the Clerk a minimum of NINE (9) copies prior to the start of the meeting so the information can be distributed to the Council.
NOTICE
If you challenge any action of the City Council in court, you may be limited to raising only those issues you or someone else raised at the public hearing described in this notice, or in written correspondence delivered to the City Council at, or prior to, the public hearing. (Gov. Code 65009(b)(2).

ACCEPTANCE OF 2016 SHSGP GRANT AWARD AND APPROPRIATION OF FUNDS
RESOLUTION 2017-_____: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF LA HABRA HEIGHTS ACCEPTING GRANT AWARDED BY THE STATE HOMELAND SECURITY GRANT PROGRAM (SHSGP) FOR 2016 AND DESIGNATING THE CITY MANAGER TO ACT AS THE CITY'S REPRESENTATIVE AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS IN THE AMOUNT OF $37,000 FOR SHSGP 2016
RECOMMENDATION: It is recommended that the City Council:
A. Adopt Resolution No. 2017-__ accepting grant awarded by the Homeland Security Grant Program for 2016, designating the City Manager to act as the City's representative, and appropriating funds in the amount of $37,000 for HSGP 2016 to the Fire Department Budget; AND
B. Authorize the Fire Department to purchase portable radios radios and body armor using the $37,000 HSGP Grant funds awarded.
OR
C. Reject the 2016 HSGP $37,000 grant award.
